claims.text: Users frequently praise it for being easy and quick to use, often drying and straightening hair in about ten to twenty minutes.
Many reviewers say it delivers great results, leaving hair straight, polished, and with good volume or lift.
Some users find it takes a very long time to dry hair and does not get warm enough.
A few reviewers note the tool is large, which some find helpful for lots of hair but others find unwieldy or unsuitable for long thick hair.
Some users mention the brush end gets very hot, requiring care when holding it.
